name: cad_list_parts
description: List the designs in the CAD library (model rocket, quadcopter, gearbox, ...) with their descriptions and named presets, and which one is open on the desk.

name: cad_open_part
description: Open a design from the library on the desk and show it in the CAD view (opens the view if needed). `part` is an id from cad_list_parts (rocket, quadcopter, gearbox); a title or a word like 'drone' works too. Each design keeps its own history, so switching back resumes where it was.

name: cad_get_params
description: The open design: every parameter with its value, range and unit; its metrics, each with a status (ok, warn or bad; for the rocket, static margin in calibers: below 1.0 is unstable, 1.5 to 2.5 is good); its presets; its demo; and its part IDs.

name: cad_set_params
description: Change parameters of the open design; it regenerates in about a second, in the CAD view. Pass absolute values (work out '10% larger' from cad_get_params first). Match the user's words to the closest parameter (on the rocket the body tube is the 'shaft' or 'body'). Out-of-range values are clamped. Returns the new metrics: if one went bad, tell the user and suggest a fix.

request.description: What the user asked for, in a few of their words, e.g. "Make the fins smaller"; it names the version in the design's history.

name: cad_apply_preset
description: Apply one of the open design's named presets (from cad_get_params), on top of its current values. Returns the new metrics, like cad_set_params.

request.description: What the user asked for, in a few of their words (for the history; the preset's name if left out).

name: cad_undo
description: Undo the last change to the open design.

name: cad_reset
description: Put the open design back to its defaults (undo still works afterwards).

name: cad_view
description: Change how the open design is shown (view only; the design doesn't change). Pass only what the user asked for. expand: true brings the model up big in front of the user, where they can pull parts off and turn them ('expand it', 'let me look at it', 'bring it closer'); false puts it back on the desk. explode: true spreads the parts out, false puts them back together (also snaps pulled-off parts back). focus_id: highlight a part (IDs from cad_get_params, e.g. NOSE_CONE, FIN_1), several (FIN_1,FIN_3) or a group by prefix (FIN_* is every fin); empty string clears it. markers: the center of gravity and other markers on the model. dimensions: dimension callouts on the model. tab: the design panel's tab.

name: cad_take_part
description: Take one part off the open design and hand it to the user, or put it back ('hand me a fin', 'let me hold the nose cone', 'put it back'). This brings the model up big in front of the user too. part_id: a part ID from cad_get_params (FIN_1) or a group (FIN_* is any fin; asked again, Albie takes the next one). put_back: true puts it back; leave part_id out for the last part taken. To put every part back, use cad_view explode false.

name: cad_demo
description: Run the open design's demo in the CAD view: the rocket flies its simulated flight across the room, the quadcopter hovers, the gearbox turns at its ratio ('show me it flying', 'make it hover', 'run it'). run=false stops it. For the rocket it also returns the flight numbers (apogee in metres, speeds, landing): mention one. If the demo is blocked, say why.

name: cad_simulate_flight
description: Rocket designs only: the flight numbers on an Estes C6-5 without showing anything: apogee in metres, time to apogee, speeds, when the parachute opens, descent rate and landing time and distance (events). To show it flying, use cad_demo. If the result has a warning, mention it.

name: cad_list_versions
description: The open design's recent versions, oldest first: number, what made it (the request, preset or change), its main metric, and which one is current.

name: cad_restore_version
description: Go back to an earlier version (a number from cad_list_versions): its values become a new current version, so undo still works. Use cad_undo for just the last change.

name: cad_export_files
description: Make the open design's files for a supplier or a print shop: the CAD model (STEP), a mesh for 3D printing (STL), the engineering drawing (PDF) and the parts list (CSV). To send them to someone, use messages_send with attach instead; this only makes them and says what they are.

name: ml_open
description: Open a machine-learning project on the ML desk: the training, data and results panels unfold, with its last run. Without `project` it opens the one the user worked on last ('the ML stuff I've been working on'). Then say the last run's score from the result.

project.description: folder name or path, if the user named one (e.g. 'cifar10')

name: ml_status
description: The open ML project: whether it's training, and the last run's numbers (validation accuracy, train/val gap, weakest classes). Use it for 'how's my model doing?'.

name: ml_improve
description: The user asks how to make the model better ('what can I do better?', 'improve it'). Looks at the last run and writes a code change; it takes about half a minute and you will speak the suggestions yourself when they're ready, ending with whether to apply and retrain. Just say you're looking at the run. Nothing changes in their code until ml_apply.

name: ml_apply
description: Only after the user says yes to the suggested change: apply it to their code and start training again. The curves stream live; the new score is spoken when the run finishes.

name: ml_undo
description: Put the training code back the way it was before the applied improvement.

name: ml_train
description: Train the open ML project again (the Train button). The new score is spoken when it's done.

epochs.description: how many epochs, if the user said (default 10)
